desc: 柠黄珊瑚双拼色块展台，厚切原块切面微距，家常炖香场景与留空凭证收口
name: 双拼色块原切牛腱肉款

shots.intent: 在搜索与列表页一眼抓住点击，用双拼色块与墨绿盘把整块原切肉说清楚
shots.textZone: 顶部左侧约 35% 预留主标题位与一行短副标位，供「{selling_point_1}」占位；其余画面不再排字

shots.intent: 一秒讲清最强购买理由，把整块原切与卤炖两用主张立起来
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏留主标题位「{selling_point_2}」，两张卡各自中部留一条短标签位「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 放大买肉最怕踩到的坑：来路不明的散碎边料与发暗无光的表面
shots.textZone: 右下角留一枚空圈标记位，圈旁一条短标签位供「{callout_2}」占位

shots.intent: 用同机位同景别的双栏对照，让人自己看懂整块与散碎的差别
shots.textZone: 两栏顶部各留一条短标签位，左栏「{callout_3}」、右栏「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 用切面肌理微距做实证，让质地本身替卖点说话
把生的原切成因端上餐桌的成品，完成从食材到一餐的代入
shots.textZone: 左上留一条标题位，字色奶油白「{selling_point_3}」；画面其它位置不排字

shots.intent: 用立起来的厚切切边讲清分量与刀工，配三枚圆牌标注质地
shots.textZone: 右上三枚珊瑚色圆牌位自上而下留给「{callout_5}」「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」，圆牌外不排字

shots.intent: 给出三条吃法方向，让不同需求的买家都能对上号
shots.textZone: 每条编号带右侧留一条短标签位「{callout_8}」，共三处，其余位置不排字

shots.intent: 把参数与包装讲清楚以降低决策风险，所有数值一律留空卡位
shots.textZone: 顶部一条标题位「{selling_point_4}」，参数卡只保留六行空行与空值格，右侧留一枚空章位

shots.intent: 以留空凭证位与冷台收口降风险，真凭证与真数字一律后贴
shots.textZone: 底部通栏留一条收口位「{selling_point_5}」，右上三枚凭证位一律留空不排字

style.backgroundSystem: hard-edged two-block pop field: a lemon plane #F4DE73 meeting a coral wedge #F5A5A2 on one straight diagonal, no gradient and no scenery; information screens switch to a flat cream card wall #FCF3E1; the closing screen runs on a frost floor #E4EAEA with a pine-green liner #245248
style.direction: bright cold-chain pop-market fresh meat commerce
style.iconSystem: flat single-weight line icons in #C9462F plus solid disc labels in #F5A5A2; no shaded 3D icons, no foil borders, no photographic badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool daylight-balanced 5600K studio grade, broad key from the upper left with a large fill card, short grounded contact shadows, one controlled specular on cut faces, no rim light, no spotlight falloff, no candlelit warmth
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bright cold-chain pop-market fresh meat visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a lemon plane #F4DE73 meeting a coral wedge #F5A5A2 in one hard-edged diagonal two-block field, a flat cream card wall #FCF3E1 for information screens, and a deep pine-green glazed serving dish #245248 as the only dark anchor; cool daylight-balanced 5600K grade, never amber or candlelit; one wide modern geometric sans-serif in charcoal #3A342E with vermilion line icons #C9462F and solid coral disc labels #F5A5A2; flat matte colour-block planes plus a crushed-ice chill bed #DCE4E6, no gradient, no wood board, no linen or woven cloth; broad key from the upper left with a large fill card, short grounded contact shadows and one controlled specular on cut faces; the subject always presented as firm whole raw cuts on the pine-green dish or in the ice bed, cooked styling only in the serving-idea screens; generous copy margin held on the upper left of every screen; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no warm amber food grade, no dark charcoal studio field, no stock-photo garnish clutter, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no amber or candlelit food grade on any screen, the whole set holds the cool daylight 5600K grade
no dark charcoal or black studio field, no ribbed slate plinth and no dramatic spotlight falloff
no wood board, no linen or cloth weave, no rice paper and no rustic market-stall surface
no fifth hue beyond lemon, coral, cream and pine green, no gold keylines and no foil seal borders
no legible brand marks, QR codes, membership pills, coupon corners or store and platform wording
style.presentationRules: the subject is always one firm whole raw cut or a single loose layer of cuts on the pine-green dish or in the ice bed, dish turned the same quarter to frame at the same scale; cooked serving styling appears only in the two serving-idea screens; nothing cropped by the frame edge
style.surfaceSystem: crushed-ice chill bed #DCE4E6 inside a deep pine-green glazed oval dish #245248, or a smooth cream card plane #FCF3E1 laid flat; never a wood board, never a woven cloth
style.typography: one wide modern geometric sans-serif, display lines in charcoal #3A342E and label lines in the same family at a lighter weight; every in-image line stays a placeholder slot rather than reproduced source copy
